description: The file defines the HomeFragment class, which is a main screen fragment for an Android TV application. It manages UI components including a hero carousel, 'Continue Watching' and 'TV Channels' horizontal rails, integrates Compose-based top navigation, handles D-pad navigation with focus management, and includes auto-scrolling logic for the hero carousel. It also observes ViewModel states to load and display content dynamically, with focus gating mechanisms to control user interaction flow.
